content:
maria: Heads-up, regen produced a nondeterministic import reorder in the sampleapp yesterday and CI flipped a minor release gate.

sam: ugh, saw that. CI shows a type mismatch caused by import order changing.

ci-bot: CI failed on branch feature/onboard-sampleapp - job: sampleapp-build (typecheck) - see: https://ci.internal/3950001234

maria: here's the tiny diff that triggered it:
```diff
- import { createClient } from '../../sdk';
- import type { User } from '../../sdk/types';
+ import type { User } from '../../sdk/types';
+ import { createClient } from '../../sdk';
```
The generator regens the index exports with a different stable sort depending on Node's object iteration order in one of our helper maps.

jordan: Is this the same chaos we saw a while back where type-only vs value imports reorder and ts up-leveling treats them differently? :face_with_monocle:

sam: yeah. Type-only imports moved above value imports, TS emits them differently in compiled JS and our test harness complains.

lee: quick workaround: force `import type` to always be grouped after values in the index. But that's a hack.

maria: repro steps for anyone who wants to try locally:
```bash
git checkout feature/onboard-sampleapp
yarn && yarn regen && yarn build
# or run: ./scripts/regenerate-all.sh --openapi --typegen
```
If you run `yarn regen` repeatedly you can sometimes get a different ordering.

dx-bot: Suggestion: add `stableSort: true` to the typegen config in repo config. Also adding a regen snapshot test for sampleapp would catch this.

sam: +1 to snapshot test. For now which release strategy? patch or minor? changelog shows no user-facing API change, just ordering.

jordan: semver-wise it's a non-functional churn. We should avoid bumping minors. Patch release fine but we must ensure publish parity across SDKs (go/python/java).

lee: we could pin the typegen tool to the current commit on the release branch as a short-term fix. That keeps CI green without a release.

maria: Plan: 1) open a tiny PR to enforce stableSort in typegen config + regen, 2) add snapshot test for sampleapp import tree, 3) pin generator on release branch. I'll open the PR now and tag @sam for review.

sam: sounds good. Also can we add a CI step that runs `yarn regen --check` to fail on diffs before build? That would prevent this slipping through.

dx-bot: Action items recorded: [stableSort flag], [regen-snapshot test], [regen-check CI step], [pin typegen on release branch].

maria: created PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/regendiff-fix/12 - includes regen + test. cc @sam @lee

ci-bot: Note: queued a rerun of the failing job on the PR build.

sam: thanks. once merged we should backport to release branch and do a patch publish.

jordan: also file a tiny postmortem note in #devex: one paragraph so PMs know no API impact.

maria: will do. closing the loop after PR merges. :thumbsup:
